name: memory
description: Knowledge Graph Memory MCP server — persistent cross-session memory with entities, relations, observations. Adapted from modelcontextprotocol/servers.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create new entities in the knowledge graph. Each entity has a name, entityType, and observations list.

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create relations between entities. Relations are directed: from → to with a relationType.

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add new observations to an existing entity. Append-only (P9).

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Delete entities (BLOCKED if APPEND_ONLY=true). Use only in maintenance mode.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph. Loaded by Fase 0 alongside MEMORY.md.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search entities by query string (fuzzy match on name, type, observations).

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Open specific entities by name (exact match).

persistence.policy: append-only (P9). New observations added; never delete. Corrections via new entity with '[CORRIGE-<name>]' prefix.
